name: Call to Arms

angles.text: Hammerfall is isolated in the Arathi Highlands, with hostile forces around it. Defending the outpost matters as the Horde tries to hold a place in human lands.
Hammerfall occupies the grounds of a former Second War internment camp. As an orc, defending this new settlement against hostile neighbors carries the weight of liberation.
As a Darkspear troll serving Thrall's Horde, you face the hostile Witherbark forest trolls. Their rejection of the new Horde marks a sharp divide between your peoples.

faq.answer: Drum Fel, an orc at Hammerfall in the northeastern Arathi Highlands, calls the Horde to fight. He directs defensive and offensive strikes to protect the outpost from nearby threats.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Call to Arms?

faq.answer: The Witherbark forest trolls have joined the Boulderfist ogres in trying to drive the Horde from the Arathi Highlands. Their hostility puts Hammerfall's foothold at risk.
faq.q: Why is Hammerfall targeting the Witherbark trolls?

aliases: where to find axe throwers arathi
faq.answer: The Witherbark trolls live in settlements and camps south of Hammerfall, including deep in Witherbark Village near the mountains.
faq.q: Where are the Witherbark trolls located?

faq.answer: The Boulderfist are a brutal ogre clan in the Arathi Highlands. Drum Fel says they have joined the Witherbark trolls in trying to drive the Horde from the highlands.
faq.q: What role do the Boulderfist ogres play in this conflict?

faq.answer: Hammerfall is the Horde's main outpost in the Arathi Highlands, named for Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer. It occupies an old Alliance internment camp and gives the Horde a hard-won sanctuary and military base in the Eastern Kingdoms.
faq.q: What is Hammerfall and why does it need defending?

aliases: are forest trolls friendly to horde
faq.answer: No. The Witherbark are forest trolls native to the Eastern Kingdoms, while the Darkspear jungle trolls belong to the Horde. The Witherbark reject outsiders and have violently refused the Horde's offers.
faq.q: Are the Witherbark trolls part of the Horde?

sections.body: At Hammerfall, Drum Fel rallies the Horde from its fortified outpost in the Arathi Highlands. Old human ruins and hostile powers surround the settlement. The Witherbark forest trolls and Boulderfist ogres have made a pact, putting the Horde's foothold at risk. Drum Fel calls on champions to strike first and keep their enemies from deciding the struggle's course.
sections.title: Defending Hammerfall

sections.body: South of Hammerfall, the Horde's first strikes reach Witherbark territory. The forest trolls have rejected diplomacy and joined the Boulderfist ogres in trying to drive the Horde from the highlands. Hammerfall targets their axe throwers, headhunters and witch doctors to weaken their leaders and show that the Horde intends to stay.
sections.title: The Witherbark Threat

summary: Drum Fel calls the Horde to strike from Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. The Witherbark have joined the Boulderfist ogres, and the Horde means to hold its foothold there.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call to Arms
